output.summary: A fast-growing annual whose native range is obscure but reportedly spans temperate Eurasia, the Indian subcontinent, North Africa, Ethiopia, and the eastern and central United States. Its lower leaves are toothed and roughly diamond-shaped, while upper leaves have a whitish, mealy underside. Young shoots may be eaten raw or cooked; leaves, flower buds and flowers are preferably cooked, and the seeds also have traditional food uses.
